measures.title: Replacing Coroners with Medical Examiners
measures.summary: Amends the Albany County Charter to repeal the elected office of County Coroner and replace it with an appointed Office of Medical Examiner within the County Department of Health. A Chief Medical Examiner, who must be a licensed physician with forensic pathology expertise, would be appointed by the County Executive for six years, subject to confirmation by the County Legislature.
measures.yesMeans: The elected office of Coroner is repealed and replaced with the appointed office of Medical Examiner.
measures.noMeans: The elected office of Coroner stays in place.

measures.title: Establishing Additional Qualifications for County Legislators
measures.summary: Amends the Albany County Charter to set grounds on which a County Legislator may be found unqualified to hold office, such as ceasing to live in the county or district, a felony conviction while in office, or knowingly filing a materially false financial statement. It also lets the County Legislature investigate and discipline its members for misconduct, up to and including expulsion.
measures.yesMeans: The additional qualifications and discipline procedures for County Legislators are added to the County Charter.
measures.noMeans: The County Charter is left unchanged.
